root: ^Tell me, in what world do you reside?
^A bad one, I don’t want to go back to it again.
^So I need to fix this one, get it back to a better version.
^It’s the only thing keeping me sane at this point, look at me.
^Every day I’m getting closer to death’s door. It’s not long now.
^It’s never too late, don’t you know the people here have come to respect me?
^No! I mean, yes I am. Oh shit, what I meant was:
^They would love you, even if you were to look like me.
^You may think you’re too old, but is prolonging your suffering better than just letting it fester?
